report.answer_text:
David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize for his novel *Flesh*. It was named the winner at a ceremony in London on Monday, 10 November 2025.[1]
Author: Szalay is the first Hungarian-British writer to win the Booker Prize.[2] He was born in Canada, grew up in London and now lives in Vienna.[3]
Prize: The prize is worth £50,000.[4]
Judges: The panel was chaired by Roddy Doyle, who won in 1993. He was the first Booker winner to chair a judging panel.[1]
Shortlist rivals: Szalay beat Susan Choi, Katie Kitamura, Ben Markovits, Andrew Miller and Kiran Desai.[4]
The separate International Booker Prize for 2025 went to Banu Mushtaq's *Heart Lamp*. Mushtaq won it with her translator, Deepa Bhasthi.[5]
